subject: Vendor onboarding: PO backlog reconciliation and spend-cap confirmation
messages:
From: Ari Stein <ari.stein@vendorco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood onboarding & PO request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the signed MDA (vendorco_onboarding_form.pdf, signed-mda-vendorco.pdf). We need a PO number to kick off the initial month of service and to submit invoices — our billing team requests the PO and any spend cap information you have so they can align.

Requested start: 2026-05-15
Est. monthly spend: $18,500 (may vary)
Billing contact: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clouddata.io>

Can you confirm next steps and when a PO will be issued?

Thanks,
Ari Stein
Head of Operations, VendorCo
---
attachments: vendorco_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), signed-mda-vendorco.pdf (PDF)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Stein <ari.stein@vendorco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding & PO request

Hi Ari — thanks for sending the form and MDA. Looping in Ben from Finance so we can get a PO number out.

Ben — vendorco submitted the MDA and onboarding form. They estimate ~$18.5k/mo to start. Two quick asks before we push a PO:
- Confirm our standard spend cap / billing terms (Finance)
- Are there any required line-item codes or GL mapping for VendorCo invoices?

Ari — if you have a preferred Purchase Order template or specific invoice line item descriptions, attach that and I’ll include it in the PO.

Next step: Ben to reply with PO + any line item adjustments.

Best,
Soojin
Sr. Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference

From: Ari Stein <ari.stein@vendorco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clouddata.io>
Date: 2026-05-12T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding & PO request

Thanks Soojin — attaching a sample invoice and preferred line descriptions. No special PO template from our side. If helpful, our AP prefers the PO to reference the signed MDA by DocuSign envelope ID.

Sample invoice fields:
- Service code: VENDOR-INF
- Description: LLM inference consumption (tokens)
- Month: YYYY-MM

Attached: sample-invoice-vendorco.pdf

Alicia will handle billing distribution.

Regards,
Ari
---
attachments: sample-invoice-vendorco.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ari Stein <ari.stein@vendorco.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: PO issued: PO-2026-45678 (needs line item mapping)

Team — I issued PO-2026-45678 to VendorCo and uploaded the signed PO to vendor records (PO-2026-45678-signed.pdf). A few notes:

1) Spend cap: We set an initial monthly cap of $22,000 while they ramp (this gives 20% headroom over their estimate). If they need more, they should submit a spend increase request via procurement.
2) Line items: Our AP requires GL codes on each line. Vendor's sample invoice uses a single service code (VENDOR-INF). We need either: (a) Vendor to provide GL mapping per line, or (b) we map VENDOR-INF to GL: 541200 (Cloud services) and create a secondary descriptor for usage.
3) Billing address: VendorCo's billing address on the onboarding form looks outdated; Ari — please confirm the billing address and remit-to details so the PO matches the invoice.

Action items:
- Ari: confirm billing address and provide any GL mapping (due 2026-05-21)
- Soojin: if they can't map, prepare a line-item correction file for AP to accept
- Neha: hold payment until invoices match PO line items (standard control)

Ben Carter
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
---
attachments: PO-2026-45678-signed.pdf (PDF)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ari Stein <ari.stein@vendorco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO issued: PO-2026-45678 (needs line item mapping)

Ben — thanks for issuing the PO. Ari — we created a short CSV with suggested line-item splits to help AP match invoices (attached: lineitems-corrections.csv). Suggested mapping (example):
- VENDOR-INF-CORE -> GL 541200 -> Base inference compute
- VENDOR-INF-OVERAGE -> GL 541210 -> Overage charges (if applicable)

If you can confirm these labels or provide your own mapping by Friday (2026-05-28), we'll finalize PO metadata and push to AP. Also flagged the billing address discrepancy; please confirm full remit-to lines.

Marissa — when confirmed, can you mark the vendor onboarding as "Ready for AP" in the vendor tracker and update the onboarding date to 2026-05-25?

Thanks,
Soojin
---
attachments: lineitems-corrections.csv (CSV)

From: Ari Stein <ari.stein@vendorco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clouddata.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO issued: PO-2026-45678 (needs line item mapping)

Thanks — confirmed the billing address and approved the suggested mapping. We will split invoices with the two line items (VENDOR-INF-CORE, VENDOR-INF-OVERAGE) going forward. Also attached the signed PO with billing details populated (PO-2026-45678-signed.pdf).

One small note: please send final PO metadata to our AP contact at procureops@orchardcloud.com so their system can ingest the PO automatically.

Alicia and I confirm start-of-service on 2026-05-25.

Best,
Ari
